name: E2E-SEEDV-011 — 数据落表(ODPS s_g_afd_material_prod_record_df)
description: 验证视频种草生产记录落表到taobao_tec_platform.s_g_afd_material_prod_record_df,重点把接受消息时间落表方便统计任务量和任务耗时
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草视频链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页(获取cobweb API域+cookie)
[造数] 调用分层修改API将商品设为F0(触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED->种草生产)
[造数] 验证分层修改API调用成功

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: 'ODPS落表', odpsTable: 'taobao_tec_platform.s_g_afd_material_prod_record_df', fields: { relation_id: 'batch关联(20227)', batch_id: '按link_id+日期聚合', item_id: '商品ID', gmt_create: '收到通知的时间(msgPushTime)', msg_push_time: 'JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info,msgPushTime)', status: '生产状态', extra_info: 'JSON扩展' }, ds: 'MAX_PT分区', tenant_id: 'f88', env: 'prod', expected: { msgPushTimeRecorded: true, gmtCreateNotNull: true, relationId20227: true } }; })()

(() => { const s = ${odpsSpec}; return { validation: 'ODPS落表校验', checks: [ { name: 'gmt_create落表', expected: '收到通知时间 NOT NULL', pass: s.expected.gmtCreateNotNull === true }, { name: 'msg_push_time落表', expected: 'extra_info.msgPushTime 可读', pass: s.expected.msgPushTimeRecorded === true }, { name: 'relation_id', expected: '20227', pass: s.expected.relationId20227 === true }, { name: 'tenant_id', expected: 'f88', pass: s.tenant_id === 'f88' }, { name: 'ds分区', expected: 'MAX_PT可查', pass: true } ] }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 视频总开关打开;F0商品已成功提交并生产完成
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.触发F0视频种草 2.等待生产完成 3.查询ODPS表taobao_tec_platform.s_g_afd_material_prod_record_df 4.验证字段值
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①gmt_create不为NULL ②extra_info.msgPushTime可读 ③relation_id=20227 ④tenant_id=f88 ⑤ds=MAX_PT
_testDesign.dbAssertion: SELECT item_id, batch_id, gmt_create, status, JSON_EXTRACT(extra_info,'$.msgPushTime') FROM taobao_tec_platform.s_g_afd_material_prod_record_df WHERE ds=MAX_PT() AND tenant_id='f88' AND env='prod' AND relation_id=20227 AND item_id=${seedVideoItemId}
riskPoints: ODPS小时表延迟可能导致查询不到
relatedDocs: PRD:种草视频生产任务自动创建 §4数据落表
